limitations: Sampling is externally enabled/disabled after observing the requested marker prefixes. Both control acknowledgments are required. Pipe/control latency and sample skid mean this approximates the wrapper interval rather than an exact source-clock boundary. Startup before start marker and external serialization after end marker are excluded; work inside the wrapper interval remains included.

Profiling changes execution time. No battles/sec or unprofiled millisecond inference is supported. A configured expected nonzero exit is diagnostic-only and never qualifies a complete normal workload.
Self groups classify linked symbol names and are disjoint. Inlined code is attributed to its containing native symbol; unresolved samples are retained. Inclusive report rows overlap.
Source mappings refer to exact function ranges in the frozen source modules; anonymous functions are not assigned invented mechanic names.
A matching supplied final reference is a separate semantic report check, not broad corpus or full-scene qualification. Without --reference, semanticReportMatched stays null.
